summary: Frontend-only font swap verification: Playfair Display + Manrope fully removed and replaced with Google Sans (weight 400 body, 500 headings/display/chapter-tag). Hind Siliguri retained as Bengali-script fallback. All programmatic checks (computed font-family, computed font-weight, document.fonts inventory, global stale-font scan, .font-bn family ordering) pass. Regression smoke on bottle-scene visibility (hero + source) and cta-order modal open confirmed.
action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup (non-blocking): /app/frontend/public/index.html still injects a <link rel=stylesheet> for Google Fonts Inter:wght@600, but no element in the app uses Inter (computed fontFamily scan of every DOM node returns 0 matches). Safe to remove that link tag to reduce a wasted network request.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css @import correctly requests Google Sans ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400;1,500 + Hind Siliguri 400;500;600 — matches spec.
body font-weight:400, .font-display/.chapter-tag font-weight:500 — matches 'Regular for body, Medium for headings' requirement.
.font-bn correctly lists 'Hind Siliguri' before 'Google Sans' so Bengali glyphs (which Google Sans lacks) render from Hind Siliguri; English-only nodes keep Google Sans as primary.
Leftover Inter stylesheet link in public/index.html is dead weight (no element uses Inter) — recommend removal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Font migration is verified programmatically. document.fonts shows many 'unloaded' entries per family — that is expected because Google Fonts' CSS splits each weight into multiple unicode-range subsets; only subsets containing glyphs currently on-screen flip to 'loaded'. At least one entry per required (family, weight, style) combination showed status='loaded'. When testing the OrderModal, note the Dialog root does NOT expose role='dialog' on its outermost node — use a more specific selector (e.g. text 'Choose your bottles' or an internal data-testid) rather than [role=dialog].

h2.text: From the deep earth of Bangla.

verification_details.cta_order_modal: Modal 'Choose your bottles' visible after click (visual confirmation via screenshot). role=dialog attribute not set on outer node, so JS check via [role=dialog] returned false — non-issue.
